part: Page composition — Obligation register (/regulations/register), item D2
source: UI fix round 2026-09-08, operator item D2, verbatim: "'Obligation register' with four dropdowns and a 1967-first table -> its own page /regulations/register in the frame with the standard facet bar, sorted by next due, not by oldest." Coordinator note N4: this route has NO artboard, so the values measured here are the STANDARD FRAME's own (README §0.3: 20px 40px 40px padding, minmax(0,1fr) 300px, 28px gap, 300px rail) plus the structural facts the item states.
notes: No artboard exists for this route. Every expectation below is either a README §0.3 frame value or a fact the operator's own item states, never an invented one; when the artboard lands this spec is re-derived from it.

The four page-local <select> dropdowns are the shape the item names for removal. The forbid on `select` is the attack surface for that half of the item: restoring the dropdown row makes this spec report NOT IN SPEC.

The facets are the SHARED rail Filters card (FiltersRailCard, ListSurfaceRailCards.tsx), the same component the five list surfaces mount, carrying live per-option counts from read-register.mjs's own corpus-wide tally.
Sort order is a query fact, not a rendered one — it is proven by src/lib/obligations/read-register.test.mjs (planRegisterPageSegments and the page-walk test), not here.

764px is the content column this harness's 1440 mount produces (nav 252 + page padding + 28px gap + 300px rail), the same value every other compose-*.json spec measures since fold 60 — see compose-10-map.json's own note. The artboards' own column is 778; the 14px difference is the harness's frame, not a product deviation.

children.name: the page carries the shared masthead, once
the register renders inside one section card with the dark-grey 3px section rule
the register's own table is present (the implementation moved across, not rebuilt)
the facets are the SHARED rail Filters card, not a page-local control
all four register facet groups render in the rail (jurisdiction, mode, binding position, due)
facet rows are checkboxes with a live count each, as on every other list surface
children.note: The fixture's dueWindow tally carries all five non-'all' windows; 'all' is the no-filter state and is never a row.

children.name: the rail order is Filters, then Obligations, then Legend
children.note: Sibling-combinator placement check: matches only when the three rail cards are in that DOM order.

forbid.name: no page-local dropdown control anywhere on the register page
forbid.reason: Operator item D2 names the register's "four dropdowns" as the shape it leaves behind; its facets are the standard rail Filters card. A restored <Select> row matches here.

forbid.name: the register never renders a second search or ask control beside the command bar
forbid.reason: README §0.3: the command bar in the masthead is the only search/ask surface.
